login.title: Adult sign-in
login.subtitle: Create an account or sign in with email and password.
login.instantSessionHint: To sign in right after sign-up: turn off “Confirm email” in Supabase (Authentication → Providers → Email).
login.signUpConfirmation: Account ready—you’re signed in if email confirmation is off in Supabase.

authErrors.invalid_credentials: Wrong email or password. If you just signed up, use the password you chose.
authErrors.email_not_confirmed: Account not activated yet. Turn off “Confirm email” in Supabase (Auth → Email) for instant sign-in, or click the confirmation link in your inbox.
authErrors.user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists. Switch to “Sign in” and use the password you set when you registered.
authErrors.weak_password: Password is too short or weak (Supabase usually requires at least 6 characters).
authErrors.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
authErrors.signup_disabled: Sign-ups are disabled in your Supabase project settings.
authErrors.no_session_after_signup: Sign-up recorded but you weren’t signed in automatically: disable “Confirm email” in Supabase (Authentication → Providers → Email), then try signing in.
authErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again or check your Supabase settings.

kidsLogin.title: Let’s go!

kidsLogin.finePrint: We save this on this device to personalize the welcome. Parents can still use the adult space for the family account.
